record.one_liner: Cloud work-management platform for boards, items, projects, and workflows, with CRM and service products built on the same platform.
record.auth_notes: Personal V2 API token goes in the Authorization header to https://api.monday.com/v2. It acts as the user and has all scopes. OAuth2 is documented for apps: auth.monday.com/oauth2/authorize and /token. The page notes a newer OAuth 2.1 flow with expiring tokens.
record.access_notes: The personal token is available from the Developers section of any account. The authentication page also describes a free developer account for testing. The rate-limits page lists a Free-plan cap of 200 API calls/day, and says the cap can be raised with a paid API add-on. I did not find a page stating which plan tiers can use the API. App review for public marketplace distribution is not covered by the pages I fetched.
record.blocker: Free plan is limited to 200 API calls/day. Personal tokens, private apps and non-marketplace public apps all count against it. Higher limits need a paid add-on. Breadth is inferred from the GraphQL schema and examples, because I did not fetch a full object list. Marketplace/public distribution review requirements are unconfirmed.
